properties.title: 120th Precinct exterior restoration was completed
properties.short_description: NYC DDC's March 2018 feature documented completion of an exterior renovation of the landmarked 120th Precinct station house on Richmond Terrace in Staten Island.
properties.explanation: A civic police station building reached documented post-restoration status after brick, terra-cotta stone, roof, window-sill, copper lining, mortar-joint, and stone-cleaning work.

properties.title: 1755 Watson groundbreaking was announced
properties.short_description: NYC HDC announced on December 13, 2018 a start-of-construction milestone for 1755 Watson, a 326-unit mixed-income, mixed-use affordable housing development in Soundview.
properties.explanation: A documented city housing-finance announcement recorded the start of construction for a Bronx affordable housing development.

properties.title: 236 and 238 President Street were designated individual landmarks
properties.short_description: LPC Designates 236 And 238 President Street In Brooklyn As Individual Landmarks records "236 and 238 President Street were designated individual landmarks" with source date 2018-09-18.
properties.explanation: A documented official LPC designation press release recorded individual landmark designation.

properties.title: 3 World Trade Center opened
properties.short_description: New York YIMBY recorded 3 World Trade Center opening on 11 June 2018 with a ribbon-cutting hosted by Silverstein Properties.
properties.explanation: A new supertall office tower entered use on the World Trade Center site.

properties.title: New 40th Precinct station-house construction began
properties.short_description: The NYC Mayor's Office announced on 10 July 2018 that construction had begun on the new 40th Precinct Station House at 567 East 149th Street.
properties.explanation: A documented construction-start milestone covered a planned 42,000-square-foot NYPD station house with community event space and green-roof elements.

properties.title: 53rd (now 101st) Precinct Police Station was designated an individual landmark
properties.short_description: The NYC Landmarks Preservation Commission designation report records the 53rd (now 101st) Precinct Police Station, LP-2610, as designated on May 29, 2018.
properties.explanation: An official LPC action designated the Far Rockaway police station as an individual landmark.

properties.title: 540 West 26th Street received DOB temporary occupancy status
properties.short_description: NYC DOB Certificate Of Occupancy records temporary CO issuance for new-building job 121184690 at 540 West 26th Street beginning in 2018.
properties.explanation: DOB issued temporary certificate-of-occupancy records for a new building at 540 West 26th Street.

properties.title: 603 Mother Gaston Boulevard opening was announced
properties.short_description: NYC HDC announced on May 3, 2018 a grand-opening milestone for 603 Mother Gaston Boulevard, a supportive and affordable housing development in Brownsville.
properties.explanation: A documented city housing-finance announcement recorded opening of a supportive and affordable housing building.

properties.title: Arrow Recreation Center playground reconstruction was marked completed
properties.short_description: NYC Parks' Capital Project Tracker lists tracker 1004111 for the Arrow Recreation Center playground reconstruction as completed, with construction actual completion in March 2018.
properties.explanation: A Parks capital tracker row recorded completion of playground reconstruction at Arrow Recreation Center.

properties.title: AT&T Corporate Headquarters Building at 550 Madison Avenue was designated an individual landmark
properties.short_description: LPC Designates The AT&T Headquarters Building As An Individual Landmark records "AT&T Corporate Headquarters Building at 550 Madison Avenue was designated an individual landmark" with source date 2018-07-31.
properties.explanation: A documented official LPC designation press release recorded individual landmark designation.

properties.title: Baisley Pond Park east-side drainage project completed
properties.short_description: NYC DDC and DEP announced on 13 August 2018 that a street, sidewalk, sewer, and drainage project along the east side of Baisley Pond Park had been completed.
properties.explanation: The project added storm sewers, catch basins, sidewalks, curbs, water-main work, and a new outfall/headwall beside Baisley Pond Park.

properties.title: Barnard College held the Milstein Center grand opening
properties.short_description: Barnard College's official news page records the Cheryl and Philip Milstein Center for Teaching and Learning grand opening on October 3, 2018.
properties.explanation: A documented opening or public-use milestone was recorded for the named facility.

properties.title: Beach Channel Senior Apartments development opened in Far Rockaway
properties.short_description: NYC HDC announced on November 20, 2018 the opening of Beach Channel Senior Apartments in Far Rockaway.
properties.explanation: A documented housing-finance release recorded opening of senior affordable housing with community and medical facility space.

properties.title: Beach Green Dunes II broke ground
properties.short_description: NYC HDC recorded on June 1, 2018 that HPD, HDC, and development partners broke ground on Beach Green Dunes II in Far Rockaway.
properties.explanation: A documented public housing-agency announcement recorded the construction-start milestone for a resilient affordable-housing development.

properties.title: Benjamin Franklin High School was designated an individual landmark
properties.short_description: The NYC Landmarks Preservation Commission designation report records Benjamin Franklin High School, now Manhattan Center for Science and Mathematics, LP-2596, as designated on March 27, 2018.
properties.explanation: An official LPC action designated the East Harlem school building as an individual landmark.

properties.title: Boerum Hill Historic District Extension was designated
properties.short_description: LPC Designates A New Historic District In Brooklyn records "Boerum Hill Historic District Extension was designated" with source date 2018-06-26.
properties.explanation: A documented official LPC press release recorded historic district extension designation.

properties.title: Bronx River Art Center reopened after capital renovation
properties.short_description: Bronx River Art Center's capital-program page records that its 100-year-old, 18,000-square-foot building reopened in May 2018 after nearly seven years of construction and $11 million in capital funding.
properties.explanation: A renovated cultural and arts-education facility returned to public/institutional use in West Farms.

properties.title: Central Harlem-West 130-132nd Streets Historic District was designated
properties.short_description: LPC Designates A Historic District In Central Harlem records "Central Harlem-West 130-132nd Streets Historic District was designated" with source date 2018-05-29.
properties.explanation: A documented official LPC press release recorded historic district designation of row houses, apartment buildings, and institutions.

properties.title: Chelsea Health Clinic renovation was completed
properties.short_description: NYC DDC recorded that renovation of the NYC Health Department's Chelsea Health Clinic at 303 Ninth Avenue was completed in March 2018.
properties.explanation: A civic health clinic building reached documented post-renovation status with upgraded interior, building systems, accessibility features, windows, lighting, emergency power, plumbing, electrical, fire alarm, and stairwell work.

properties.title: citizenM New York Bowery opened
properties.short_description: citizenM's press coverage recorded the New York Bowery hotel opening on 12 September 2018 as the brand's second New York address.
properties.explanation: A modular hotel tower entered hospitality use on Bowery with compact rooms, public lounges, rooftop bar, and museum-format public spaces.

properties.title: The Forum opened at Columbia's Manhattanville campus
properties.short_description: Columbia University's Office of the President recorded the formal opening of The Forum on 26 September 2018 as the third new building on the Manhattanville campus.
properties.explanation: A new university auditorium, meeting, and community-facing building entered use in Manhattanville.

properties.title: Coney Island Riegelmann Boardwalk was designated a scenic landmark
properties.short_description: New York City's Iconic Coney Island Boardwalk Becomes A Designated Landmark records "Coney Island Riegelmann Boardwalk was designated a scenic landmark" with source date 2018-05-15.
properties.explanation: A documented official LPC designation press release recorded scenic landmark designation.

properties.title: DeMatti Park reopened after Community Parks Initiative reconstruction
properties.short_description: NYC DEP recorded an April 2018 opening for the newly reconstructed DeMatti Park in Rosebank, Staten Island, after a Community Parks Initiative project with DEP green-infrastructure funding.
properties.explanation: A reconstructed neighborhood park returned to documented public use with spray showers, adult fitness space, bocce courts, added seating, accessible features, redesigned landscape, and stormwater infrastructure.

properties.title: Special Jerome Corridor District zoning text was adopted
